crossRefs.note: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city. The destruction of the poor is their poverty.
Riches don’t profit in the day of wrath, but righteousness delivers from death.
For their rock is not as our Rock, even our enemies themselves concede.
“If I have made gold my hope, and have said to the fine gold, ‘You are my confidence;’
If I have rejoiced because my wealth was great, and because my hand had gotten much;
Those who trust in their wealth, and boast in the multitude of their riches—
God will likewise destroy you forever. He will take you up, and pluck you out of your tent, and root you out of the…
Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
God has spoken once; twice I have heard this, that power belongs to God.
For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life…
I will tell my soul, “Soul, you have many goods laid up for many years. Take your ease, eat, drink, and be merry.” ’

translations.web: The rich man’s wealth is his strong city, like an unscalable wall in his own imagination.
translations.bsb: A rich man’s wealth is his fortified city; it is like a high wall in his imagination.
translations.kjv: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, and as an high wall in his own conceit.
translations.asv: The rich man's wealth is his strong city, And as a high wall in his own imagination.
